Console.Title: Planar Glitch
Console.RecordDeathHint: For deaths the module can't see: massive damage, disintegration, a fall.
Console.RecordDeathConfirm: Record a death for {name}? Their token is hidden and the body is left where it stands.
Console.NoDeaths: No one is dead right now.
Console.InCombat: The fight is still on: they come back after it ends.
Console.Offline: The player isn't connected. Roll here instead.
Console.Asking: Waiting for {name} to turn the Wheel and choose…
Console.FoundAtPlaceholder: e.g. inside a wardrobe in M4
Console.WaitingRest: Waiting for the party's next long rest.
Console.Unhide: Show the token where it is
Console.Drop: Drop an item here to give it to them, born of this death.
Console.RaisedHint: Brought back by magic before the glitch took them: no glitch.
Console.RaisedConfirm: {name} was raised before the glitch took them? The body is removed and the token comes back where it lay. No glitch.
Console.ReplaceHint: The player goes on with the character you pick.
Console.ReplaceConfirm: {from}'s player goes on as {to}? They get ownership of {to}, and you place the token next.
Console.CancelHint: A mistake: undo everything and drop this death from the log.
Console.CancelConfirm: Undo this death and remove it from the log?
Console.MendConfirm: Undo {name} on {actor}? Everything it changed goes back.

Return.spent: Full HP, spent resources stay spent

Wheel.Title: The Wheel turns
Wheel.Intro: You died. The multiverse is putting you back together, and it never gets it quite right.
Wheel.Base: Unless the Wheel says otherwise, this return is a {tier}.
Wheel.Rules: Roll the d20. On a 1 it gets worse, on a 20 lighter.
Wheel.Worse: The Wheel turns against you: one tier worse.
Wheel.Both: The Wheel turns against you: both of them come back with you.
Wheel.Lighter: The Wheel is kind: one tier lighter.
Wheel.Same: The Wheel turns. Nothing more, nothing less.
Wheel.ChooseIntro: Two probable versions of you. Which one comes back?
Wheel.BothIntro: Both of these come back with you.

Unity.Title: End the glitch: {name}
Unity.Intro: For each glitch: keep it as part of who they really are, or release it and let it go back to how it was.

Catalog.Default: The glitch list shipped with the module.
Catalog.Imported: Shipped list plus the imported pack "{name}".
Catalog.ResetConfirm: Remove the imported pack and use only the shipped list?
Catalog.PreviewHint: Pick a character to see which glitches fit them now.
Catalog.Invalid: That pack has {n} problems; see the console (F12). Nothing was saved.

Sheet.Kept: kept at the end of the glitch
Sheet.Nexus: Nexus: the glitch never touches it

Card.Speaker: The glitch
Card.Title: {name} is back. Not quite the same.

Tracker.Title: Glitch Tracker
Tracker.Intro: Every death of a player character, written by Planar Glitch. Fill in the memory fragments in the module's Log tab.

Notify.Timeout: The GM didn't answer in time.
Notify.OnlyGM: Only the GM can open the Glitch console.
Notify.NotAsking: That death is no longer waiting for the Wheel.
Notify.NoCandidates: No glitch fits this character at any tier. Check the catalog.
Notify.DoesNotFit: That glitch doesn't fit this character now.
Notify.NoAnswer: {name} didn't choose. Roll from the console.
Notify.ClickToPlace: Click where they turn up. Esc cancels.
Notify.CombatOver: The fight is over: {names} can come back.
Notify.Rested: The party has had a long rest: {names} can come back.
Notify.Recovered: The item is back with its owner.

detectSaves.Name: Death on three failed death saves
detectSaves.Hint: Record a death when a player character fails their third death saving throw.

detectDead.Name: Death on the Dead status
detectDead.Hint: Record a death when a player character gets the Dead status (for example, marked defeated in combat).

autoOpen.Name: Open the console on a death
autoOpen.Hint: Open the Glitch console for the GM as soon as a death is recorded.

askPlayer.Name: The player turns the Wheel
askPlayer.Hint: Open the Wheel on the player's screen so they roll and choose. Off: the GM rolls and chooses in the console.

wheel.Name: Roll the Wheel
wheel.Hint: Roll a d20 for each return: 1 makes the glitch one tier worse, 20 one tier lighter. Off: the tier comes from the death count only.

defaultReturn.Name: Default return
defaultReturn.Hint: How characters come back unless you choose otherwise for that death.

corpse.Name: Leave the body
corpse.Hint: Leave a grey, empty copy of the token where the character died.

textLanguage.Name: Glitch text language
textLanguage.Hint: Language for glitch names and texts written to the sheet. Automatic uses the GM's language.

trackerName.Name: Tracker page name
trackerName.Hint: Name of the journal page that logs every death.

padDeath.Name: Soundboard pad: death
padDeath.Hint: Planar Soundboard pad to play when a death is recorded (leave empty for none).

padReturn.Name: Soundboard pad: return
padReturn.Hint: Planar Soundboard pad to play when a character comes back (leave empty for none).

fx.Name: Glitch screen
fx.Hint: Show the short glitch screen on this client when a character comes back.
